jobs.title: Business Analyst - Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
**Vi är inte som andra fastighetsbolag. Vi är Balder.**


Vill du vara med och utveckla hur Balder använder data för analys, uppföljning och bättre beslutsfattande?


Vi söker dig som vill kombinera stark verksamhetsförståelse med ett praktiskt arbete inom data och Power BI. Här får du en central roll i att utveckla Balders analysförmåga och skapa lösningar som gör data mer tillgänglig, tillförlitlig och användbar i verksamheten.

**Om rollen**


Som Business Analyst – Data \& Analytics omsätter du verksamhetens analysbehov till tydliga KPI, datakrav och användbara beslutsstöd. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta våra rapporter i Power BI och säkerställer att data, definitioner och beräkningslogik är korrekta och enhetliga.


Tillsammans med verksamheten och våra tekniska datateam driver du utvecklingen från behov och kravställning till validerad data och färdig analyslösning. Du bidrar även till att utveckla nya sätt att använda data, exempelvis genom självserviceanalys och möjligheten att chatta med data.

**I rollen kommer du även att:**

* Definiera affärsregler, beräkningslogik, dimensioner och gemensamma begrepp tillsammans med verksamheten.
* Omsätta analysbehov till tekniska krav på datakällor, datamodeller, transformationer och dataflöden.
* Driva och prioritera utvecklingsbehov mot dataplattformen tillsammans med data engineers, arkitekter och andra tekniska specialister.
* Praktiskt analysera, felsöka och validera data och logik genom hela flödet, från källsystem till rapport.
* Utveckla dashboards och semantiska modeller i Power BI.

**Vi söker dig som har**

* Flerårig erfarenhet av att utveckla rapporter och analyslösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Djup praktisk kompetens inom Power BI, inklusive DAX, Power Query, datamodellering, semantiska modeller och prestandaoptimering.
* Goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att analysera, transformera, felsöka och kvalitetssäkra data.
* God förståelse för datalager, dimensionell modellering och dataflöden.


Har du en bakgrund som BI\-utvecklare, Data Engineer eller liknande teknisk roll ser vi det som ett stort plus. Erfarenhet av Snowflake, utveckling av datalager eller dataplattformar samt generativ AI, semantiska lager och lösningar som gör det möjligt att ställa frågor och chatta med data är även det starkt meriterande.

**Vem är du?**


För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du gillar att arbeta nära verksamheten och förstå vilka frågor och behov som faktiskt behöver lösas med hjälp av data. Du är analytisk och tekniskt nyfiken, men också praktiskt lagd och trivs med att själv undersöka, utveckla och kvalitetssäkra lösningar. Du tar initiativ och driver arbetet framåt, samtidigt som du kan göra komplex data och tekniska samband begripliga och användbara för andra.

**Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?**


Kul! Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg/Stockholm, med arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.


I denna process ber vi dig inte skicka med personligt brev, utan vill i stället att du besvarar våra urvalsfrågor. Vi använder oss av rekryteringstester för att hjälpa oss göra ett så bra och objektivt urval som möjligt. Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kommer även ett arbetsprov att tillämpas.


Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterare Gabriella Hagström, gabriella.hagstrom@balder.se.


Hjärtligt välkommen till oss och en bransch som är full av möjligheter!

jobs.title: VIE Consumer Insights Analyst
jobs.description:
**What is a VIE?**


It’s an international graduate program for European citizens having graduated from a University School. This is an initiative created, designed, and supported by the French Government primarily to provide professional international work experience for European citizens aged between 18\-28 recently graduated from University or Business School.


To apply for this V.I.E assignment you need to fulfil the following criteria:

* International Graduates (European citizens) between 18 \- 28 yo with an average of 12 months of professional experience
* Higher education level (master’s degree)
* Fluent in English
* International profile (work experience or studies abroad)
* Eager to continue your career abroad
  

This is a V.I.E position based in Stockholm, Sweden and lasts 12 months with possibility for extension of another 12 months. The position is not open to applicants already based in Stockholm, Sweden.


For more information on the V.I.E program’s specificities please visit Mon Volontariat International : site officiel du V.I.E \| V.I.A (businessfrance.fr)

**ABOUT****US**


The Absolut Company oversees the production, packaging and marketing of Absolut Vodka, Kahlúa and Malibu as part of the Pernod Ricard Group, a global leader in spirits and wine. Based in Stockholm, Sweden, and part of Pernod Ricard’s Crystal Brand Unit, we uphold the Group’s commitment to excellence by offering some of the world’s most renowned and enduring spirits.


We aim to redefine the global spirits market by inspiring people from all backgrounds to connect, share ideas and enjoy our products responsibly. We are also committed to long\-term sustainability, acting in the best interests of consumers, society, the environment and our employees.


We seek talented, bold individuals to join our team and drive innovation. After all, our brands are defined by lifestyle and mindset, but it is our people who define who we are. So, whether you are just starting your career or looking to take it to the next level, we offer a dynamic and supportive work environment that will help you grow.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


Starting in December 2026, this V.I.E position is based in Stockholm, Sweden and lasts 12 months with possibility for extension of another 12 months.

  

The Global Consumer Insights role in the Crystal Brand Unit exists to support and work with the Absolut Global Insights Manager working as a strategic business partner to the Absolut Brand Team, leveraging consumer understanding to guide and challenge strategy, planning \& activation development.


In addition, the role will help drive Consumer Centricity, a key ingredient in The Pernod Ricard brand building model, across the business by putting consumers and shoppers at the heart of all decision making. As such, this role is an ambassador for the consumer and shopper voice, both in and externally.


Ultimately, they will develop and share actionable insights \& enhance consumer knowledge, leading, and partnering with Marketing / Brand teams to unlock new approaches / frameworks for insights adoption.

 **KEY TASKS \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Contribute to the development of Absolut’s long\-term ambition and strategy based on robust consumer, shopper and category insights
* Help identify innovation opportunities based on consumer insights
* Support the Brand Team in testing and validating the global portfolio strategy, leading communications campaigns, winning brand concepts, packaging, design, format innovation, wetgoods, and optimal portfolio ranges with consumers
* Actively engage in industry research and trends, anticipating future consumers or market needs and share those insights and learnings throughout the team
* Help manage our Absolut Consumer Councils to gain valuable qualitative insights on our initiatives on an ongoing basis
 **WHY JOIN US**

  

We aspire to foster an authentic, open, challenging and innovative culture that supports your long\-term professional development. And so, we have created a working environment at The Absolut Company that allows you to thrive.

  

We champion inclusion and value different perspectives. We want our people to be their own authentic selves and we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our global consumer base. We are proud to be recognised among Forbes World's Best Employers and Equileap's top 100 Employers for Gender Equality. Conviviality is in our DNA and connects us beyond borders – you will always be welcomed for who you are and the strengths you bring.


This role could be for you if you:

* Hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Mathematics, Economics)
* Demonstrate strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns or irregularities in large quantities of data
* Have experience with social media, including usage and analysis, social listening tools, and website analytics
* Possess design skills to create easy\-to\-read reports and real\-time dashboards, and effectively showcase insights and data to support the brand team’s understanding
* Be fluent in English; additional languages are a plus
* Have experience in project management
 **O****UR OFFER**

  

We want to help you through everyday challenges, encourage you to make healthy choices, take care of your well\-being and enjoy work\-life balance (we have a great canteen and a well\-equipped gym in case you want to shake the day off!). We also provide you with opportunities for professional development and career progression that you’d expect from a global leader in the beverage industry.

  

Read more about us at Careers \| The Absolut Group (theabsolutcompany.com)

 **APPLICATION**  

  

If this role sounds like it is for you, don’t hesitate to apply. As an international company, our working language is English, so please submit your application in English. All new employees are subject to a six\-month probationary period and

jobs.title: Accounting Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**We’re looking for an Accounting Business Analyst for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.**

 **Accounting Business Analyst**


We are seeking a highly experienced accounting specialists for a consulting assignment within a large\-scale financial transformation initiative.


The role requires strong hands\-on experience in accounting and reconciliation of financial records in a complex enterprise environment. You are expected to independently analyse, design and document financial business processes from multiple front\-end systems, detail resulting accounting patterns, in a complex enterprise environment.


﻿

 **ART Initiative**


The company is running an initiative called ART, Accounting and Reporting Transformation, with the objective of moving accounting functionality from several legacy accounting solutions to a new cloud\-based solution.


Integration with other systems is ongoing, including business applications delivering accounting data, source systems, and downstream consumers of accounting and reporting information.


﻿

  

The initiative includes several agile teams working across IT development, integration, infrastructure, security, and business processes. The solution includes development of customized bank\-specific functionality running on dedicated server instances in the Oracle sovereign cloud, updates to legacy systems, and configuration and integration of an accounting SaaS solution provided by Oracle.


﻿

 **Required Skills \& Experience**


Strong ability to analyse accounting, reconciliation and reporting requirements and translate them into process descriptions, accounting patterns and system requirements


Hands\-on and broad accounting experience and confident in describing accounting scenarios, for example using T\-accounts


Strong ability to train and coach end\-users to confidently and efficiently use the resulting accounting solutions


Experience in planning, preparing and executing tests of financial processes and accounting solutions in a large, multinational enterprise


Experience with financial services, accounting, regulatory reporting, and other highly regulated business domains


Experience working in agile development teams and collaborating across application, integration, test, and business functions


Strong written and spoken English communication skills


﻿

 **Education**


Master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field


Equivalent professional experience may be considered


﻿

 **Preferred Qualifications**


Experience in integrating large scale and custom business applications using Oracle Financials Cloud or similar, comprehensive accounting system


Experience in Change Management, organizational transformation, and user training


﻿

 **Key Responsibilities**


Analyse functional and non\-functional requirements and translate those into accounting and configuration specifications


Translate business, accounting, reporting and reconciliation requirements into implementable system requirements


Support configuration, operation, and maintenance of an accounting solution based on Oracle Financials Cloud and other supporting financial solutions


Collaborate with business stakeholders, system architects, and development teams to clarify functional and non\-functional requirements


Produce and maintain high\-level and low\-level design documentation and test\-scripts


Support testing, deployment, release, troubleshooting, incident analysis, and remediation in non\-production and production environments


Contribute to common accounting standards, reconciliation principles, and ways of working


Participate actively in agile ceremonies and cross\-team planning


Share knowledge and provide solution guidance to other project team members when required


Training and coaching end\-users in using the configured solution


﻿

 **Personal Attributes**


Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills


High attention to quality, details and consistency


Ability to work independently and take end\-to\-end ownership of deliverables


Mind\-set to drive continuous improvements within areas of responsibility but also within the team


Structured and methodical approach to complex assignments


Pragmatic mindset and ability to balance long\-term targets with delivery needs


Effective communicator with both technical and business stakeholders


Comfortable working across accounting, system, reporting, and operational boundaries


Collaborative and team\-oriented, with experience from agile environments


Able to document and explain accounting solutions and business decisions clearly


Proactive in identifying risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities


﻿

  

This role requires fluency in English.

  

This is a full\-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 9 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

  

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on\-going basis.


For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: IT Business Analyst (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
**IT Business Analyst (f/m/d)**

Essity is a global, leading hygiene and health company. Every day, our products, solutions and services are used by a billion people around the world. Our purpose is to break barriers to well\-being for the benefit of consumers, patients, caregivers, customers and society. Sales are conducted in approximately 150 countries under the leading global brands TENA and Tork, and other strong brands such as Actimove, Cutimed, JOBST, Knix, Leukoplast, Libero, Libresse, Lotus, Modibodi, Nosotras, Saba, Tempo, TOM Organic and Zewa. In 2024, Essity had net sales of approximately SEK 146bn (EUR 13bn) and employed 36,000 people. The company’s headquarters is located in Stockholm, Sweden and Essity is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More information at essity.com .


Ready to shape how manufacturing teams turn business needs into digital solutions? Want to collaborate globally and drive meaningful improvements across factory operations? Join Essity and help break barriers to well\-being through technology.


**About the Role**

Join Essity's Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) team and play a key role in connecting business stakeholders with technical experts. As an IT Business Analyst, you will work closely with manufacturing sites worldwide to understand operational needs, translate them into clear requirements, and support the delivery of digital solutions that improve efficiency, quality, and business performance.


You will be part of an international team supporting the Proficy MES solution and collaborating with stakeholders across factory operations, digitalization, and IT.


This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys problem\-solving, stakeholder engagement, and driving continuous improvement in a global environment.


**What You Will Do**

* **Business Analysis:** Gather, analyze, and translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and solution specifications.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Facilitate workshops, interviews, and meetings with business and technical teams to identify needs, opportunities, and priorities.
* **Solution Development:** Collaborate with design and development teams to ensure solutions are aligned with business objectives and requirements.
* **Project \& Delivery Support:** Contribute to project planning, stakeholder alignment, risk management, testing coordination, and successful solution deployment.
* **Business Transformation:** Support process improvements, change management activities, user training, and the adoption of future\-state ways of working.
* **Application \& Service Support:** Assist with user requests, incident management, and continuous improvement initiatives across the supported application landscape.
* **Digital Innovation:** Identify opportunities for digitalization, automation, analytics, and AI\-driven solutions to enhance manufacturing performance and business outcomes.

**Who you are**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Analysis, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and translating business needs into clear functional requirements and user stories.
* Experience supporting manufacturing systems, IT\-enabled operations, or digital transformation initiatives; familiarity with Velotic MES, Azure DevOps, Proficy, SQL databases, or SAP is advantageous.
* Strong communication, facilitation, collaboration, and project coordination skills, with a proactive mindset and the ability to drive continuous improvement and challenge constructively.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Ability to travel internationally.

**What We Can Offer You**

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well\-being, provides meaning to everything we do. Working at Essity means a chance to improve well\-being for people and opportunities to drive positive change for the society and the environment. As an employee at Essity, you will belong to an organization where you feel valued and supported to grow and challenged to generate business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere.
  

**Innovate for Good \| Excel Together \| Be You with Us**

**Location**

This role is based in one of Essity’s key European hubs: Gothenburg (Sweden), Munich (Germany), Lisbon (Portugal), Barcelona (Spain).

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Debtor Management Solutions
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst to help develop and advise on ØS Indsigt, our solution for accounts receivable and debtor management, used by organizations across the public and private sector.

**As part of the department**  

You will join a team of skilled and dedicated employees who advise municipalities and regions on how the ERP solution ØS Indsigt can improve their business.


Our team has a proud tradition of close collaboration and dialogue with customers on how the solution can help make their work processes more efficient. By gaining a deep understanding of users' needs and challenges, we innovate and create solutions that provide real value for the end user.  

  

**Your Role: Solve, Recover, Advance**  

As our new Business Analyst, you will play a key role in this collaboration. You will also be responsible for tasks such as:

* Preparing solution descriptions for new features.
* Testing and documentation.
* Implementing ØS Indsigt at new customers.
* Training super users.
* Supporting customers' super\-users.

**You are the ideal candidate if you**  

It is important that you take responsibility and are driven by your own motivation. As the ideal candidate, you will also have most of the following skills:

* Have experience with municipal billing and collection.
* Have knowledge of debt collection for public authorities.
* Have Interest in the technology behind the ØS Indsigt system.
* Have the ability to understand and work through complex issues.
* Have experience using AI tools and a strong interest in AI.
* Are self\-driven when it comes to finding tasks and learning new IT systems.
* Have strong ability to prioritize your own tasks.
* Are able to build good relationships with customers and colleagues.
* Have a positive and curious personality.
* Are fluent in spoken and written Danish.
* Are able to communicate clearly in English, in both writing and speech.

**What's in it for you?**

* A challenging everyday work life in dialogue with municipal specialists.
* A professional, business\-driven environment with exciting projects and complex challenges.
* Highly skilled and dedicated colleagues who know that they only get better through collaboration and active knowledge sharing.
* Good opportunities to develop your personal skills and help improve our solutions further.
* Management support that promotes psychological safety and allows room for feedback and development.
* Influence over how your work is planned, and flexibility to help you balance work and free time
* A strong focus on health and well\-being.
* Hybrid working, meaning the option to work from home as well as staying close to your colleagues at the office.


Your workplace will be Ikast or Aarhus.

**Our Values**

* Lead the Industry \- We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen \- We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together \- We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.

**We look forward to hearing from you!**  

If you would like more information before you apply, please feel free to contact Manager Lene Langelund on \+45 2069 9900\. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**  

Our industry\-specific software help people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.


Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security.


If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here. You'll be trusted to grow your skills, shape meaningful solutions, and make an impact together with talented colleagues across borders.


Join us in creating software that works for people \- not software that makes people work.
